newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.01 percent in higher trade boosted by the first market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.26 points, up from 446.20 on Monday.
Total volume was 754,799 dinars against 364,630 dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 579,662 dinars with 35,238 shares changing hands.

Arab Tunisian Bank was up 0.74 dinar to 25.76 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie rose 0.1 dinar to 29.5 dinars. The Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurances Tuniso-Europeenne advanced 0.1 dinar to 37 dinars with the exchnage of 1,230 shares.
Insurance firm ASTREE was down 0.66 dinar to 21.62 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat eased 0.47 dinar to 15.21 dinars with 5,250 shares changing hands.
Placement de Tunisie edged lower 0.27 dinar to 11.72 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF declined 0.2 dinar to 13.6 dinars.
